source_claim: Sanrio's official Copyright Info page explicitly lists all 14 campaign characters as Sanrio character properties, including the variant English forms Badtz-Maru, Monkichi / Osaru no Monkichi, and U*Sa*Ha*Na. Sanrio's official Japanese character pages provide direct profiles for campaign members including Cinnamoroll, Cogimyun, Gudetama, Hangyodon, Pochacco, and Wish Me Mell.
notes: Sanrio's first-party Copyright Info directory lists all campaign members: https://www.sanrio.com/pages/copyright-info (Badtz-Maru, Cinnamoroll, Cogimyun, Gudetama, Hangyodon, Kuromi, My Melody, My Sweet Piano, Monkichi / Osaru no Monkichi, Pochacco, Pompompurin, Tuxedosam, U*Sa*Ha*Na, Wish Me Mell). Official Sanrio Japan character profiles independently confirm representative exact identities: https://www.sanrio.co.jp/characters/cinnamon/, https://www.sanrio.co.jp/characters/cogimyun/, https://www.sanrio.co.jp/characters/gudetama/, https://www.sanrio.co.jp/characters/hangyodon/, https://www.sanrio.co.jp/characters/pochacco/, https://www.sanrio.co.jp/characters/wishmemell/. The direct rightsholder roster makes these direct Sanrio character-home proposals rather than inference through a franchise relationship.
